ctx.x: Oh, it was a very good rhythm section. Very good. Paul Barbarin, you mean?
Mmm-hmm. Well, I mean the whole thing, with Pops, Barbarin, Johnson...

Yeah, and Luis Russell, too. Very good. They had that real Dixie...that real New Orleans beat -- because they were from down there. So Paul and Pops Foster, they knew what they was doin'. And Russell was brought up around there, New Orleans. Yeah, they had that beat all right.
